task_description:
Set up and execute a repair-and-return workflow for the non-operational cardio equipment:

1) Create a new location for in-progress repairs:
   - location_id: LOC-REPAIR-777
   - name: Repair Bay
   - description: Secured service area for in-progress equipment repairs.

2) Move both the Spire EL-500 elliptical and the Ranger X-Plus bike from their current locations into LOC-REPAIR-777.

3) For the Spire EL-500 elliptical (currently out of order):
   - Add a maintenance record dated 2024-06-06 performed by technician Charlie Henson describing: “Main circuit board replaced; full diagnostics passed.” Notes: “Cleared prior critical status.”
   - Update its condition to operational.
   - Return it to its original location (Eastside Cardio Gym).
   - Reflect a post-repair test run in its usage statistics by increasing usage_count by 1, increasing usage_hours by 0.2, and setting last_used to 2024-06-06.

4) For the Ranger X-Plus bike (currently requires maintenance):
   - Add a maintenance record dated 2024-06-06 performed by technician Ryan Ng describing: “Full drivetrain service; console battery replaced.” Notes: “Noise eliminated.”
   - Update its condition to operational.
   - Return it to its original location (Wellness Annex).
   - Reflect a post-service test ride in its usage statistics by increasing usage_count by 1, increasing usage_hours by 0.1, and setting last_used to 2024-06-06.

5) Update the Wellness Annex location description to append: “Includes refreshed bikes as of 2024-06.”
